QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Captain's Secret Tastes
QuestInfo.1: You entered the Captain's Quarters but it seems rather... pink. Even the Black Viking himself is wearing very strange clothes. He attacked you out of the blue, perhaps out of surprise or shame. Not that there's anything wrong with pink...
QuestInfo.2: Turns out the Black Viking just has particular tastes. His hobbies include cross-stitching and knitting. That's not so weird... but he really needs to stop ranting about being a victim.
QuestInfo.0: You pieced together the secret puzzle pieces only to reveal a selfie of the captain. Enter the Captain's Quarters to find out what's going on.

yes.0: Hey, wait! I'm a victim too! That mushroom told me the most beautiful princess in the world lives here, but I only found some coyote ugly spore-thing! I've been played! Fooled!
